items.definition:
a nomadic Arab of the desert
The Bedouin people have a rich nomadic culture.

a person who sees or observes someone or something
Beauty is in the eye of the beholder.

a town or city (informal)
It's a quiet little burg in the countryside.

a survey of opinions or votes
The political party conducted a door-to-door canvass.

a machine with a rapidly rotating container that applies centrifugal force to its contents, typically to separate fluids of different densities
The lab technician used a centrifuge to separate the blood components.

a store, especially in a military base or prison, where food and supplies are sold
Soldiers can buy groceries at the base commissary.

a mixture of various ingredients or elements
She made a strange concoction of herbs and spices.

a person or thing that crawls, especially a baby or a web spider
The baby is a fast crawler now.

a person who believes that people are motivated purely by self-interest
He's such a cynic; he never believes anything good will happen.

a word or expression used to describe or identify something
The term 'sustainable' is a key descriptor in environmental policy.

a change in color, especially an unwanted one.
The old photograph showed signs of discoloration.

a chemical liquid that destroys bacteria.
She used a strong disinfectant to clean the bathroom.

a book or set of books giving information on many subjects or on many aspects of one subject.
She looked up the definition in the encyclopaedia.

lack of restraint in spending money or using resources.
The party was an extravagance, but everyone enjoyed it.

a person who fakes something; an impostor.
He was exposed as a faker after his lies were revealed.

a long, narrow, deep inlet of the sea between high, steep cliffs.
The cruise ship sailed through the stunning Norwegian fjord.

a bridge, road, railway line, or similar structure that crosses over another.
Traffic was heavy on the flyover during rush hour.

the small sac-shaped organ beneath the liver, in which bile is stored after secretion by the liver and before release into the intestine.
The doctor explained that the pain was due to a problem with her gallbladder.

a unit of information equal to one billion bits
The new internet connection offers speeds of one gigabit per second.

a belt or a light corset
She wore a tight girdle under her dress.

an excessive supply or amount of something
There is a glut of oil on the market right now.

a minor complaint
His main gripe was the lack of communication.

a place for hatching eggs
The salmon hatchery released thousands of young fish into the river.

the stone forming the hearth
The cat was curled up asleep on the warm hearthstone.

a water pipe with a long flexible tube
They sat around smoking fruit-flavored tobacco from a hookah.

a type of whale with a distinctive hump
We saw a magnificent humpback whale breach near the boat.

a confused mixture or mass
The old box contained a jumble of forgotten items.

a strong, sweet alcoholic drink
She offered him a glass of cherry liqueur after dinner.

a common wild duck
A male mallard has a distinctive green head.

a type of traditional Mexican folk music, typically performed by a small group of musicians
A mariachi band played lively music at the festival.

the period of life between youth and old age, typically from about 45 to 65
Many people re-evaluate their lives during midlife.

a parasitic plant with white berries, traditionally used as a Christmas decoration
They kissed under the mistletoe at the Christmas party.

massively multiplayer online (game)
He spends hours playing his favorite MMO with friends online.

An infectious disease causing swelling of the salivary glands
The child developed a fever and swollen glands, indicating he might have the mumps.

A person who practices nudism
The nudist beach was clearly marked with signs.

A soldier trained to parachute from an aircraft
The paratrooper landed safely behind enemy lines.

An act of reorganizing or rearranging, especially a cabinet or team
The prime minister announced a major cabinet reshuffle.

The quality or state of being rough
The roughness of the stone made it difficult to hold.

An ointment used to promote healing of the skin
She applied a soothing salve to the burn.

A dirty mark or smear
There was a smudge of ink on her cheek.

A sample piece of cloth or other material
She picked up a swatch of fabric to check the color.

A board with switches for making connections in an electric circuit
The operator connected the call through the switchboard.

An electronic musical instrument that generates sounds
He played a melody on his new synthesizer.

tradesman
The tradesman fixed the leaky pipe.

undertone
There was an undertone of sadness in her voice.

whisperer
He was known as the horse whisperer because of his gentle way with animals.

wingspan
The eagle had an impressive wingspan.

the act of allowing to enter
No admittance without a valid pass.

an open-air venue used for entertainment
The ancient amphitheater could hold thousands of spectators.

a person who estimates the value of something
The art appraiser estimated the painting's value.

a person who maintains and preserves historical records
The archivist carefully preserved the old documents.

a person who uses astrology to tell the future
An astrologer claims to predict the future based on star positions.

a flat-bottomed cylindrical container used in laboratories
The chemist poured the liquid into a glass beaker.

the two-hundredth anniversary of a significant event
The town celebrated its bicentennial with a parade.

a sharp blow or punch
He gave the ball a good biff with his bat.

a ridiculous but amusing person; a clown
He acted like a complete buffoon at the party, making everyone laugh.

the center of a target
She hit the bullseye with her first dart, winning the game.

a starchy root vegetable
Cassava is a staple food in many tropical countries.

a painful muscular spasm, especially in the neck or back
I woke up with a crick in my neck after sleeping in an awkward position.

a secret or disguised way of writing; a code
The ancient manuscript contained a complex cypher that took years to decode.

a person who writes plays
William Shakespeare is considered one of the greatest dramatists of all time.

the quality of being firm
The firmness of the mattress provided good support.

the process of sprouting from a seed
The germination of the seeds was successful.

a hot spring that spouts water and steam
Old Faithful is a famous geyser in Yellowstone.
